title: Connect Hub & Integrations
description: Connect lead sources, email and external systems through verified organization-scoped setup.

pages.title: Connect Hub overview
pages.summary: Find available integration tiles, understand their prerequisites and confirm live activation.
pages.body:
## What Connect Hub includes
Open [Connect Hub](/dashboard/connect-hub/) to review the organization integrations. Current categories include:

- **SHVYA Tools:** SHVYA API and outbound Webhook.
- **CRM & Data Sync:** Google Sheets and connected Email.
- **Ads & Conversions:** Meta Lead Ad Forms and Meta Conversions API.
- **Lead Marketplaces:** JustDial and IndiaMART.
- **Calls:** Call Scheduler and Call Tracker links.
- **Payments:** Razorpay information and related payment connectivity.

WhatsApp and Instagram have their own dedicated channel connection screens. Google Calendar/Meet is configured in SHVYA Calendar, not through a generic lead-capture webhook.

## How setup normally works
1. Choose a provider tile and read its prerequisites.
2. Authorize or request the integration with an organization administrator.
3. Map the intended CRM pipeline, stage and fields.
4. Complete any required provider-side approvals, webhook registration or account access.
5. Trigger a genuine test event and inspect the resulting SHVYA lead or outbound receipt.
6. Activate production use only after the end-to-end result is confirmed.

## Connected is not necessarily delivering
A saved credential, generated URL or visible setup tile does not prove real lead delivery. Revisit the integration's event log or source record and verify the mapped CRM result. Some connections require SHVYA Superadmin provisioning.

## Before reporting a failure
Provide the provider name, organization (not its secret), destination pipeline/stage, event time, a masked test contact and any safe error code. Never share full API keys or token-bearing webhook URLs in a public ticket.

[JustDial](/docs/connect-hub/justdial/) · [IndiaMART](/docs/connect-hub/indiamart/) · [Meta Lead Ads](/docs/connect-hub/meta-lead-ads/).

pages.title: Google Sheets lead sync
pages.summary: Connect a spreadsheet, map columns and verify leads reach the right pipeline.
pages.body:
## Prepare your sheet
Use a Google Sheet your organization controls, with a stable header row and consistent Name, Phone and optional Email columns. Decide whether the sheet is a lead source, destination or both according to the active integration options.

## Configure
1. Open [Connect Hub → Google Sheets](/dashboard/connect-hub/google-sheets/).
2. Follow the available provider/account or webhook setup instructions.
3. Select the desired CRM pipeline and entry stage.
4. Map source column names to SHVYA contact and custom attribute fields.
5. Save the configuration and trigger a single identifiable test row or integration event.
6. Confirm the resulting CRM lead, source label and field values.

## Common mapping errors
- Phone values contain spreadsheet formatting or lost leading plus signs.
- A dropdown value does not match its allowed CRM option.
- Required columns are absent or mapped to the wrong field.
- The chosen stage is not active or is outside the selected pipeline.
- A duplicate normalized phone updates an existing lead instead of creating a new one.

## Sync checks
Inspect last received/sync state and any displayed errors. If a row never appears, compare the integration event receipt and original sheet row before re-running a whole import.

> Treat sheet access credentials and generated endpoints as private. Do not share customer rows in a public support post.

[CRM imports](/docs/crm-leads/import-leads/) · [Data sync troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting/integrations-sync/).

pages.title: Connected Email setup
pages.summary: Configure an authorized sender for Cadence, Workflows and sales communication.
pages.body:
## Why connect email?
Email gives SHVYA an organization-authorized channel for supported sales messages, follow-up steps and selected SHVYA Sales document delivery. It is separate from WhatsApp and does not inherit Meta's 24-hour message window.

## Set up
1. Open [Connect Hub → Email](/dashboard/connect-hub/email/).
2. Configure the supported mailbox/provider and sender identity under organization admin access.
3. Complete provider authorization, authentication and required sender settings.
4. Send a test email to an inbox you control.
5. Select the connected address in Cadence or Workflows where available.

## Good practice
Use a business-owned address and accurate reply-to identity. Verify domain/provider sending rules and recipient consent. Avoid placing credentials in lead notes, workflow text or screenshots.

## When email does not send
Check connection health, mailbox account permissions, sender selection, recipient address, worker/outbox status and any provider throttle or authentication code. A queued email does not imply a successful provider send.

[Cadence](/docs/ai-automation/cadence/) · [Sales delivery](/docs/sales-calendar/sales-documents/).

pages.title: Meta Lead Ad Forms
pages.summary: Capture Facebook or Instagram Lead Ads forms into your configured CRM pipeline.
pages.body:
## Prerequisites
You need access to the relevant Meta business Page and Lead Ad form, plus organization admin access in SHVYA. Provider lead access must be granted to the connected app where applicable.

## Connect
1. Open [Connect Hub → Meta Lead Ad Forms](/dashboard/connect-hub/meta-lead-ad-forms/).
2. Select or add the authorized Meta Page.
3. Choose the lead form to receive.
4. Map form answers to SHVYA name, phone, email, attributes, destination pipeline and stage.
5. Save and enable the form connection.
6. Submit a provider-side test lead and confirm the lead record appears with the correct acquisition source.

## What to confirm
- Meta Page and form IDs match the active campaign.
- The form is subscribed and the webhook receives lead events.
- Required phone/contact details are normalized safely.
- An existing lead may be updated rather than duplicated.
- A form submission does not itself open a WhatsApp customer-service conversation.

## If no lead arrives
Check permissions, page/form mapping, form subscription, provider event receipt and whether a duplicated contact already exists. Note the time and safe Meta lead ID for support.

[Meta Conversions API](/docs/connect-hub/meta-conversions/) · [Lead sync troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting/integrations-sync/).

pages.title: Meta Conversions API
pages.summary: Send configured CRM lead-stage conversions to the selected Meta dataset.
pages.body:
## What it does
SHVYA's Meta Conversions API integration sends selected, server-side CRM lead events to a Meta Pixel/dataset. It is separate from inbound Meta Lead Ads and separate from the WhatsApp/Instagram message APIs.

## Configure
1. Open [Connect Hub → Meta Conversions API](/dashboard/connect-hub/meta-conversions-api/).
2. Enter the correct Meta dataset/Pixel ID and securely authorize its Conversions API token.
3. Choose which lead sources and CRM stages should trigger conversion events.
4. Map event names, customer matching fields and optional value/currency.
5. Use Meta Events Manager's **Test Events** workflow and inspect SHVYA delivery status.
6. Enable live tracking after confirming the correct dataset receives accepted events.

## Important details
Event delivery can be asynchronous and retried safely by a durable outbox. Changing the dataset or disconnecting can invalidate pending work for the former destination. Customer identifiers use the provider's accepted normalization/hash rules and require appropriate consent and lawful handling.

## How to interpret a result
A successful HTTP response or accepted event does **not** guarantee attribution, match quality or campaign optimization. Check the actual selected dataset in Meta Events Manager.

## Troubleshooting
Verify dataset ID, token authorization, mapped stages, event validity, optional value/currency pairing and event receipt. Keep tokens off screenshots.

[Meta Lead Ads](/docs/connect-hub/meta-lead-ads/) · [Insights](/docs/ai-automation/insights/).

pages.title: JustDial lead integration
pages.summary: Request a private JustDial webhook and activate lead push through the advertiser account.
pages.body:
## Setup roles
For JustDial, an organization admin can **request setup**, but only SHVYA Superadmin can provision or rotate the organization-scoped webhook and choose its destination pipeline/stage.

## Activation steps
1. Open [Connect Hub → JustDial](/dashboard/connect-hub/justdial/) and choose **Request JustDial Setup**.
2. SHVYA Superadmin reviews the organization request and selects a valid pipeline and active stage.
3. Superadmin generates the private inbound URL. The organizational contact receives that exact URL through an authorized channel.
4. Share the endpoint with your JustDial account manager/support and ask them to configure the advertiser's CRM lead-push callback using **GET**, unless they supply a different account-specific contract.
5. Ask the provider to send one test enquiry.
6. Confirm the SHVYA JustDial event log, normalized phone, matching CRM lead and source/stage mapping.

## Data behavior
Incoming field names may vary by account; SHVYA uses conservative source mappings. A subsequent enquiry from the same normalized phone can update its existing lead rather than creating a duplicate. A JustDial lead does not automatically authorize a WhatsApp welcome message.

## If nothing arrives
Check that Superadmin generated an active URL, JustDial actually configured the callback, the provider used the requested method, and the first event was accepted. Request a redacted provider sample if their payload differs.

## Security
The full callback URL includes a secret token. Treat it as a credential. Rotating the URL invalidates the old callback; the advertiser must update its configuration.

[Integration debugging](/docs/troubleshooting/integrations-sync/) · [CRM lead records](/docs/crm-leads/overview/).

pages.title: IndiaMART lead integration
pages.summary: Provision Superadmin-managed IndiaMART Push API capture and validate enquiries.
pages.body:
## Provider model
SHVYA implements an IndiaMART **Push API** webhook receiver, not a client-side guaranteed real-time pull/polling integration. A configured URL is only ready to receive; the seller must activate the callback in its IndiaMART account.

## Activate
1. Open [Connect Hub → IndiaMART](/dashboard/connect-hub/indiamart/) and choose **Request IndiaMART Setup**.
2. SHVYA Superadmin selects the organization, pipeline and active stage and generates a private URL.
3. In the seller's IndiaMART Lead Manager / Push API configuration, choose the applicable external CRM option.
4. Register the private SHVYA URL and complete the provider's account/OTP verification if required.
5. Send a sample enquiry and confirm successful receipt and the corresponding CRM lead.
6. Review source attribution and mapped name, phone, product and enquiry details.

## Expected request
The receiver accepts JSON lead-push events including a unique enquiry ID and a buyer phone. Duplicate enquiry IDs are idempotent; a later enquiry from an existing buyer may append a new note without replacing the lead's current stage.

## Debugging
Verify whether the seller's panel actually sent a request, whether the URL is still enabled, the POST payload fields, data size, recipient phone and mapped destination. A rejected payload should not be silently marked imported. Provide a redacted sample and receipt/error time to SHVYA support.

## Security
Do not publish, index or paste the token-bearing URL into public screenshots. Ask Superadmin to rotate it if exposed.

[JustDial](/docs/connect-hub/justdial/) · [Lead ingestion troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting/integrations-sync/).

pages.title: Razorpay and payment connectivity
pages.summary: Understand the Connect Hub tile versus actual SHVYA Sales payment actions.
pages.body:
## Two related surfaces
**Connect Hub → Razorpay** is the provider setup/information surface available in the integration catalogue. **SHVYA Sales** manages supported invoice payment links, payment records, refunds and credit notes through its own document and payment lifecycle.

Do not assume a Razorpay tile visible in Connect Hub means an end-to-end payment-to-CRM ingestion connection is activated for your organization. Verify the actual account/provider setup and a real sandbox payment event before treating any payment as recorded.

## Payment workflow
1. Open [SHVYA Sales](/dashboard/sales/) and create or review an invoice.
2. Review your organization's configured payment gateway availability and settings.
3. Create a supported payment link where the product allows it.
4. Complete a test payment through the authorized gateway environment.
5. Confirm the invoice/payment ledger, provider status and linked lead.

## If a payment is missing
Check gateway configuration, linked invoice, checkout/session status, callback receipt, currency and webhook verification. Do not manually record a second payment until its provider state is reconciled.

## Safe handling
Never store card numbers, CVVs, gateway secrets or raw authentication headers in lead fields or support attachments.

[Invoices and payments](/docs/sales-calendar/invoices-payments/) · [Sales troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting/sales-errors/).

pages.title: SHVYA API and API keys
pages.summary: Create scoped keys and integrate external lead create/update requests.
pages.body:
## API purpose
The [SHVYA API](/dashboard/connect-hub/shvya-api/) surface allows an authorized organization admin to provision keys for supported external lead operations, and separate read-only diagnostic access where applicable.

## Getting started
1. Sign in as an organization admin and open **Connect Hub → SHVYA API**.
2. Create the appropriately scoped integration key and store it in your server's secret manager.
3. Copy the displayed lead API endpoint shown by the current Dashboard, not an assumed undocumented route.
4. Send a controlled test request using the displayed contract and one disposable lead.
5. Confirm the created/updated lead and inspect validation errors before automation is enabled.
6. Revoke keys no longer needed from the same workspace.

## API rules
- Organization identity is derived from authenticated credentials, not a customer-supplied organization ID.
- Credentials need the permission to perform the requested operation; diagnostics access does not automatically authorize lead writes.
- Duplicate requests should use supported idempotency or matching behavior to avoid unwanted duplicate leads.
- Validate all pipeline and stage identifiers to belong to the same organization.

## If API calls fail
Check the key is still active, required scope/capability, exact URL, request format, valid lead fields, destination permissions and documented rate limits. For 401/403, do not expose keys in the ticket; rotate a suspected compromised key.

[Operations MCP](/docs/operations/mcp-operations/) · [Integrations debugging](/docs/troubleshooting/integrations-sync/).

pages.title: Outgoing webhooks
pages.summary: Send SHVYA lead events to an authorized HTTPS endpoint you control.
pages.body:
## What outbound webhooks do
The webhook integration helps a downstream system react to selected SHVYA lead create/update events. It is different from inbound JustDial, IndiaMART, Google Sheets or Meta webhooks.

## Prepare your receiver
1. Host an HTTPS endpoint in your system.
2. Configure an authenticated secret and expected payload handling.
3. Open [Connect Hub → Webhook](/dashboard/connect-hub/webhook/) and enter the supported endpoint settings.
4. Save and trigger a test lead create/update event.
5. Record that your receiver returns a successful 2xx after safely processing the event.
6. Add server-side deduplication so retried deliveries do not create duplicate records.

## Expected data
Depending on enabled event configuration, common lead fields can include lead ID, contact identity, source, pipeline/stage, notes, event type and selected custom attributes. Confirm the actual configured schema rather than assuming every field is always present.

## Diagnose missing delivery
Check the active webhook configuration, destination DNS/TLS, endpoint reachability, authentication, receiver HTTP status and delivery attempt logs. Redact URL credentials and customer data from bug reports.

## Security
Never disable webhook signature/secret checks to pass a test. Use a test receiver separate from production when experimenting.

[SHVYA API](/docs/connect-hub/shvya-api/) · [Sync troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting/integrations-sync/).
